periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique, approximately 45 degrees downward relative to the coronal plane of the skull
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval with a high length-to-width ratio
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Significant downward and anterior tapering towards the muzzle

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High thickness, occupying approximately one-third of the visible torso length

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Moderate, roughly equivalent to the width of the inter-orbital distance
